full_script: Come on, let's enjoy the magic of maths together! Have you ever wondered how Vande Bharat reaches its top speed in just a few minutes? Its speed keeps increasing every second — that is acceleration! Velocity tells us how fast and in which direction the train moves. For uniform acceleration we use equations like average acceleration equals delta v over delta t. Distance, velocity, time — all linked on a straight line journey! Which NCERT topic should we do next?
